description: List the user saved recipient addresses (address book): name, networks and address. Use it to resolve a recipient the user names, e.g. "send 0.1 ETH to My work address": find the entry by name (search), take its address and confirm it with the user before calling transfer_native or transfer_asset. Informational only: transfers are not restricted to these addresses. Returns the entries and pagination, also as structuredContent.

chains.description: Only entries saved for these networks: ethereum, optimism, bsc, gnosis, polygon, sonic, zksync, base, avalanche, arbitrum, scroll, solana, ton, hyperevm, plasma, monad, robinhood
